name: research_topic_interview
description: A conversational interview to understand a friend's current research: topic, objectives, methods, progress, challenges, needed support, timelines, and planned outputs.

sections.label: Researcher Profile and Context
sections.description: Capture the person's role, affiliation, field/lab, prior relevant work, and motivation for this project to ground the interview.

sections.label: Research Overview and Objectives
sections.description: Summarize the research topic, problem statement, and primary objectives or hypotheses driving the work; exclude methods, results, or timelines.

sections.label: Methods and Data
sections.description: Document study design, methodologies, data sources, sampling/participants, instruments, protocols, and analysis techniques/software; exclude results or interpretation.

sections.label: Progress and Findings to Date
sections.description: Record milestones completed and any preliminary or confirmed results, trends, or evidence with key metrics or sample sizes; exclude future plans or asks.

sections.label: Challenges and Risks
sections.description: Note blockers, uncertainties, resource gaps, data/IRB or privacy constraints, assumptions and risks, and any mitigation strategies under consideration; exclude scheduling.

sections.label: Timeline and Upcoming Milestones
sections.description: List key dates, phases, and deadlines (experiments, data collection windows, submissions) and immediate next steps with owners; exclude broader objectives.

sections.label: Outputs and Dissemination Plan
sections.description: Capture planned or actual deliverables such as papers, preprints, datasets, code, talks/posters, and target journals/venues or audiences; exclude raw findings.

sections.label: Collaboration and Support Needs
sections.description: Identify requests for feedback, collaborators, equipment, funding, analysis help, introductions, or ways the interviewer can assist; exclude general risks without an ask.

sections.label: Other
sections.description: Anything material that doesn't fit a declared section. Prefer declared sections; use this only when nothing else fits.

phases.label: Warm-Up and Purpose
phases.goal: Build rapport, confirm the interview purpose, and capture essential background to anchor the discussion.

phases.label: Topic and Goals Alignment
phases.goal: Elicit a clear description of the research topic, problem, and objectives or hypotheses to align on scope.

phases.label: Methods and Evidence Deep Dive
phases.goal: Understand the study design, data, and what has been learned so far from completed work.

phases.label: Obstacles and Support
phases.goal: Surface key risks and blockers and agree on specific support or resources that would help.

phases.label: Planning, Outputs, and Wrap
phases.goal: Confirm upcoming milestones, intended outputs, and immediate next steps to close the conversation.
